'''Tactical Ranger Armor''' was a type of specialized tactical [[Armor/Legends|armor]]<ref name="Reveal" /> used around [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tactical-Ranger-Helmets.jpg|right|250px|thumb|The "Scrapper's," "Demolisher's," and "Codebreaker" helmets.]]
This [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> armor set debuted within the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]], announced on [[April 27]], [[2021]], as part of a tie-in promotion for the [[The Bad Batch Season 1|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''. The base set was specifically inspired by [[Clone Force 99]]'s [[Clone Sergeant|leader]], [[Hunter]], though three additional repurposed [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]] were also released alongside the set, including the "Scrapper's Helmet" imitating [[Crosshair]], the "Demolisher's Helmet" imitating [[Wrecker]], and the "Codebreaker Helmet" imitating [[Tech]].<ref name="Reveal" /><ref name="TBB">''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''</ref>
